summary: npm postinstall auto-executes bundled Windows binary launching 'virus.jar' with RAT-shaped capabilities
details: Package ships only a jpackage-produced Windows launcher (DakuMangalSingh/DakuMangalSingh.exe), a bundled JRE, and an embedded Java application whose JAR is literally named app/virus.jar (mainclass=Main). package.json declares a postinstall script that unconditionally runs DakuMangalSingh\DakuMangalSingh.exe on npm install, executing the bundled JVM payload on the installer's Windows host. The bundled Java classes include a java.awt.Robot service, a screenshot routine, a device-identifier collector, a network fetch component, and a batch command executor — the capability shape of remote-control / surveillance malware. The package has no JavaScript source, no README, empty author and description metadata, and its declared main (index.js) does not exist in the tarball; the only functional surface is the opaque binary executed at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
